title: Hardcoded credential
guidance: Secrets must come from environment variables or a secrets manager, never source code.

title: Missing webhook/signature verification
guidance: Verify HMAC over the raw request body with a constant-time comparison.

title: SQL/NoSQL injection
guidance: Validate and parameterize all user-supplied input before it reaches a database.

title: Command / code execution
guidance: Never pass user input to shell or eval; use allow-lists and safe APIs.

title: Unsafe dependency change
guidance: Pin dependency versions and review new packages.
